answer: Proposal: pay slots by capital lineage, not headcount. Each epoch a seat escrows one coin; the chain groups coins sharing transaction ancestry; one connected group holds one slot. A hoard split across N masks keeps its shared parent, so all N draw one slot: the funding trail is a cipher the ledger decodes itself, no issuer. Each coin must stay its own ember; any merge folds heads together. Extra seats need genuinely disjoint capital, a linear bill each seat's reward must out-earn; mixers can launder a coin's voyage, and wealth still scales.
